skip_reason: The skill requires macOS (Darwin OS with osascript/AppleScript) and the proprietary commercial application Airfoil by Rogue Amoeba ($35), neither of which can run in a Linux Docker container. The skill's metadata explicitly declares 'os: [darwin]' and 'requires: {bins: [osascript]}'. There is no viable way to mock or replicate AppleScript-driven AirPlay speaker control in an isolated text-only Docker environment without the macOS host and the paid application.
